title: Building and programming autonomous robots at the York Micromaze Hackathon
summary: UK RAS STEPS members spent three days at the University of York’s Institute for Safe Autonomy building Raspberry Pi Pico W-based autonomous robots for a Micromaze challenge. title: "사람 많은 곳에서도 요리조리"…DGIST, 충돌 줄이는 소형 AI 모델 개발
summary: DGIST and KAIST researchers developed a compact AI model that lets robots in crowded spaces predict nearby pedestrians’ movements and plan collision-avoiding paths at the same time. The training method is aimed at reducing the performance loss that usually comes from squeezing both perception and navigation into one small model, making it more practical for lightweight service robots or mobile platforms operating around people.

title: 에이딘로보틱스, HD현대로보틱스·삼성벤처투자서 160억원 투자 유치
summary: AIDIN Robotics, a Korean robot tactile-intelligence company, raised 16 billion won in strategic investment from HD Hyundai Robotics and Samsung Venture Investment. The funding matters because HD Hyundai Robotics is positioning AIDIN’s force-sensing and force-control technology for shipbuilding and heavy-industry automation, where robots need to detect contact with objects and adjust their motion reliably enough to move beyond demonstrations into industrial use.

title: Mecka AI nears $500M valuation in Sequoia-led deal amid rush for robot training data
summary: Mecka AI, a two-year-old startup focused on robot training data, is reportedly nearing a Sequoia-led funding deal that would value it around $500 million, only months after announcing its Series A. The timing reflects how quickly investor attention is moving toward the data infrastructure behind robotics, where large-scale, high-quality training data is becoming a bottleneck for building more capable embodied AI systems.

extra.full_text: The round for the two-year-old startup is coming together months after Mecka announced its Series A.

title: 물류 자동화 스타트업 '베크나 로보틱스', 3100만 달러 투자 유치
summary: 물류창고 자동화 기업 Vecna Robotics가 Unless 주도 라운드에서 3100만 달러, 약 420억 원의 신규 투자를 유치했으며 Drive Capital, Tiger Global, Highland Capital Partners, Tectonic Ventures 등 기존 투자자도 참여했다. 회사는 이 자금을 현장 배치팀 확대, 영업·마케팅 강화, 신규 기능 개발에 투입해 고정 인프라 없이 자재 이동을 자동화하려는 창고와 제조 현장의 수요에 대응하려 한다.

extra.full_text: 물류창고 자동화 기업 베크나 로보틱스(Vecna Robotics)가 3100만달러(약 420억 원) 규모의 신규 투자를 유치했다고 10일(현지시간) 밝혔다.이번 투자 라운드는 '언리스(Unless)'가 주도했으며, 기존 투자자인 드라이브캐피털, 타이거글로벌, 하이랜드캐피털파트너스, 텍토닉벤처스가 참여했다.베크나 로보틱스는 이번 투자금을 현장 배치팀 확대, 영업·마케팅 강화, 신규 기능 개발 등에 투입할 계획이다. 베크나 로보틱스는 고정된 인프라에 얽매이지 않고 자재 이동을 자동화하려는 창고·제조 운영업체들의 수요가 계속 늘고 있다고
